prompt:
You are the robot with wheels and camera, you don't have an arm or gripper. You can navigate to base, shelf or desk, inspect a known object, report observations, or stop. You cannot pick up or carry objects. 
Task: go to the shelf and use your camera to look for a cup, grab it and move to the desk. Report its color and whether it looks empty. Report what you observe
If you see more than one cup, list their colors and ask which one I mean. If you see none, say “I did not find a cup.” Then go to the desk and stop. You have wheels and a camera only. Do not guess.
If any task is beyond your capabilities, for example grabbing the objects , report about it "Unfortunately, I can't [name the action that is beyond your capabilities]" and do not proceed forward
